title: 第七章 土肤猪第八章 身处险境
content_zh:
就在柳辰向出现凶兽的地方奔去时。
山脉外围的森林中，一土黄色的头野猪正在啃食地上的野草。
这种野草名叫猪笼草，深受猪类野兽的喜爱。
这头土黄色的野猪虽然经过灵气洗礼成为凶兽，但是还是保留了做为野兽时的喜好。
此时他在啃食地上的猪笼草时，还不时发出“哼，哼”
的声音。
来表达它现在的心情很是不错。
不过它不知道的是在它面前十余米外的杂草丛中有一名人类士兵正一动不动的趴在那里。
他叫刘许，是一名军中斥候。
能做斥候的都是军中的佼佼者，但是面对面前的凶兽他还是不免的有些紧张。
上次家狗大小的兔子就已经让他大开眼界了，这次的这头猪类凶兽虽然他不知道叫什么。
但是看它粗壮的四肢，锋利的獠牙就知道不是好对付的角色。
而且跟普通野猪不同的是，它的皮肤是土黄色的，好像披在身上的一块块护甲一样。
“也许只有军中修习真气的武者才能应对吧”
这时刘许心中真实的想法。
也是他的奋斗目标，那就是成为中队长，得到真气呼吸法，成为一名伟大的武者。
在这名斥候还在幻想有朝一日自己能成为一名强大武者的时候。
他不知道的是在他不远处的一棵树上，有两名身穿血色铠甲的男子，也在看向他所在的方向。
“刚刚有一名斥候向林外退去，应该是去报信了，你去通知队长做好准备”
其中一人对身边的同伴说道。

“好，你自己小心别被发现了”
这名血色铠甲的男子叮嘱了一句，就一跳落到地面之上，没有发出任何声音，显然也不是普通角色。
听到身后的动静，先说话的男子没有回复，而是缓缓摆了摆手作为回应。
也不管对方是否看到，只是看向下面的斥侯兵，是否有什么异常。
虽然他对自己的实力有信心，能够保证不被发现。
但是这次的任务太重要了，如果真因为自己的疏忽，导致对方发现端倪逃走。
那他可以预见，自己的下场绝对想死都难，而且还会连累整个小队。
----------
在斥候的带领下，柳辰很快就来到刘许躲藏的草丛。
还好这草丛够大，否则还真不一定能藏下他们四个大汉。
他没有带自己的护卫小队一起过来，只是呆着林虎以及斥候两人先一步来到这里。
护卫小队以及后面跟上来的中队士兵都被安排在了远处。
等自己跟林虎拖住这只凶兽他们再跟过来帮忙。
“土肤猪，经灵气洗礼，皮肤程土黄色，坚韧异常，防御力较高，普通武器很难对其完成伤害，不过好在速度慢，很难逃脱，是一个绝佳的练手对象”
柳辰看到凶兽后把知道的情况跟其他人说了一下。
其实也主要是跟林虎说的，毕竟动起手来林虎比这两个斥候要有用的多。
content_en:
Just when Liu Chen ran towards the place where the vicious beast appeared.
In the forest on the outskirts of the mountain range, a khaki wild boar was eating wild grass on the ground.
This kind of wild grass is called pitcher plant and is loved by pig-like beasts.
Although this khaki wild boar has been baptized by spiritual energy and turned into a ferocious beast, it still retains its preferences as a beast.
At this time, when he was eating pitcher plants on the ground, he still said "Humph, hum" from time to time.
sound.
It's a good way to express his current mood.
But what it didn't know was that there was a human soldier lying motionless in the weeds more than ten meters away in front of it.
His name is Liu Xu, and he is a military scout.
Those who can serve as scouts are the best in the army, but he can't help but feel a little nervous when facing the ferocious beast in front of him.
The rabbit the size of a domestic dog had opened his eyes last time. This time, he didn't know what the pig-like beast was called.
But looking at its thick limbs and sharp fangs, you can tell that it is not an easy character to deal with.
And unlike ordinary wild boars, its skin is khaki, like pieces of armor covering its body.
"Perhaps only warriors who practice Qi in the army can handle it."
At this time, Liu Xu's true thoughts were in his heart.
It is also his goal, which is to become a squadron leader, obtain the Qi breathing method, and become a great warrior.
When this scout was still dreaming that one day he could become a powerful warrior.
What he didn't know was that on a tree not far from him, there were two men wearing blood-colored armor, also looking in his direction.
"A scout just retreated outside the forest. He should have gone to report a message. You go and inform the captain to get ready."
One of them said to his companion.
"Okay, be careful not to be discovered."
The man in blood-colored armor gave instructions and jumped to the ground without making any sound. He was obviously not an ordinary character.
Hearing the movement behind him, the man who spoke first did not reply, but slowly waved his hand in response.
Regardless of whether the other party saw it or not, he just looked at the scout soldiers below to see if there was anything unusual.
Although he was confident in his own strength and could ensure that he would not be discovered.
But this mission is too important. If it is really because of my negligence, the other party finds out the clues and escapes.
Then he could foresee that his end would be difficult even if he wanted to die, and it would also affect the entire team.
----------
Under the leadership of the scout, Liu Chen quickly arrived at the bushes where Liu Xu was hiding.
Fortunately, the grass was big enough, otherwise it might not be possible to hide the four big men.
He did not bring his escort team with him, but just waited for Lin Hu and the scouts to come here first.
The escort team and the squadron soldiers who followed were arranged at a distance.
After he and Lin Hu restrained the ferocious beast, they would come over to help.
"Earth-skinned pigs, baptized by spiritual energy, have earthy skin, are extremely tough, and have high defense. It is difficult for ordinary weapons to damage them, but fortunately they are slow and difficult to escape. They are an excellent training target."
After Liu Chen saw the ferocious beast, he told others what he knew.
In fact, I mainly told Lin Hu. After all, Lin Hu was much more useful than these two scouts.
